401-3944-4699-8125.easyPrerequisites:
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
Your life total is at least 2.
401-3944-4699-8125.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying {B}.
When Blood Pet enters the battlefield, Davvol triggers, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
When Blood Pet dies, Decaying Soil and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Decaying Soil trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return Blood Pet from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

3025-4279-4976--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
3025-4279-4976--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance, Open the Graves and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Bastion of Remembrance trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Open the Graves ability, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

2577-3967-4826-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
2577-3967-4826-7084.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-1116-3249-3755--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-1116-3249-3755--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Sek'Kuar triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

728-2033-3249-3621.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2033-3249-3621.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding mana equal to its casting cost.
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Citanul Hierophants by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

647-2105-5778-7392.description:
Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1479-2841-3318-4677.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Fabled Passage.
1479-2841-3318-4677.description:
Fetch a land using Fabled Passage.
When the fetched land enters, Zendikar's Roil and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Zendikar's Roil trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Zendikar's Roil from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Zendikar's Roil triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2921-7435--5.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with persist.
When that creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on that creature.
Remove a +1/+1 counter and a -1/-1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability from step 1.
Repeat.

280-5147-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Golgari Rot Farm.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Golgari Rot Farm.
When Golgari Rot Farm dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Golgari Rot Farm from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

6753-7839-7926.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Your commander is on the battlefield.
6753-7839-7926.description:
Activate Slag Strider by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

45-1978-5793-7008.description:
Activate Khalni Gem by tapping it, adding two mana.
Badgermole Cub triggers, adding at least one additional mana.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Khalni Gem which is an artifact creature due to Bello. 
Repeat any number of times.

338-7399-7690--165.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-7399-7690--165.description:
Gain life.
The other Hero triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Invisible Woman triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Bogwater Lumaret triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2112-3967-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2112-3967-6972.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

4658-5306-7416.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
You have Professor Dellian Fel's emblem.
4658-5306-7416.description:
Activate Disciple of Griselbrand by paying {1} and sacrificing Soul of Eternity, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness.
Professor Dellian Fel's emblem triggers, causing target opponent to lose life equal to the life you gained.

280-774-6763.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters, it triggers.
Activate Golgari Rot Farm by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Golgari Rot Farm's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1170-1328-2105-7297.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Combat Celebrant that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1328-2105-7297.description:
Declare Combat Celebrant and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, causing you to untap all other creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

1402-2218-4763-7297.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7153.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Arcbound Bruiser.
When Arcbound Bruiser dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Bruiser's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Bruiser from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

1719-5921-5970-6965.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Activate one of the Vizier of Tumbling Sands tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Vizier of Tumbling Sands token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

11-1927-4872-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-1927-4872-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Time Warp.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Time Warp spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Time Warp spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Time Warp and returning the original Time Warp to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Time Warp from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

141-413-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, Return to Action triggers, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Blasting Station abilities from step 5.

783-1399-1606-5396.description:
Cast Trickery Charm by paying {U}, causing Ley Weaver to become an Elf until end of turn.
Activate Jungle Basin by tapping it, adding {C}{G}
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Jungle Basin.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat from step 2

1029-5028-5833.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more creatures.
1029-5028-5833.description:
Activate Leafkin Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Leafkin Druid.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.
1029-5028-5833.notes: If mana allows, you can untap a creature using Tolarian Kraken's third trigger - although it is not necessary to execute the combo.

4871-5231-5913-6476.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents that each have a creature card that will enter the battlefield with greater than 0 toughness in their graveyard.
4871-5231-5913-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}, returning Pinnacle Monk and at least three other creatures from graveyards to the battlefield under your control.
When Pinnacle Monk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Afterlife from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Thermopod four times by sacrificing four of the creatures returned in step 1, including Pinnacle Monk, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}.
When the creatures die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers four times, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1174-1479-4488.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
1174-1479-4488.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Rampaging Baloths trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rampaging Baloths trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Rampaging Baloths triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

2724-3080-4013-5299.manaNeeded: {3}{C}{U}{U} the first turn with {2}{C} each extra turn
2724-3080-4013-5299.description:
Cast Exchange of Words by paying {1}{U}{U}.
When Exchange of Words enters the battlefield, it triggers, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Exchange of Words.
Exchange of Words leaves and enters the battlefield, triggering the second ability it gained from Wormfang Manta's textbox as well as its own ability.
Resolve the first Exchange of Words trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the second Exchange of Words trigger, exchanging the text boxes of it and Wormfang Manta.
Repeat from step 3 during each turn.

2793-3743-4094-5089-5436.manaNeeded: {5} available, with an additional {5} every fourth turn
2793-3743-4094-5089-5436.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
2793-3743-4094-5089-5436.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Osgir by paying {5}, tapping it and exiling Ugin's Nexus from your graveyard, creating four token copies of Ugin's Nexus.
Put three of the Ugin's Nexus tokens into exile due to the legend rule and their replacement effects, causing you to take three extra turns after this one.
Activate Karn's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, choosing to do nothing.
Move to your next extra turn.
Activate Kaya's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, giving creatures you control deathtouch until end of turn and putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature token you control.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate Karn's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, returning Ugin's Nexus from exile to your hand.
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Ugin's Nexus.
Move to your last extra turn.
Repeat.

2034-4417-5070-5944.notablePrerequisites: Unstoppable Slasher does not have a counter on it.
2034-4417-5070-5944.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Unstoppable Slasher, adding {C}{C}.
When Unstoppable Slasher dies, its second ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with two stun counters on it.
When Unstoppable Slasher enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Unstoppable Slasher's toughness.
Activate Hex Parasite by paying {2} and 2 life, removing both stun counters from Unstoppable Slasher and giving Hex Parasite +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2645-3688-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five mana-producing lands.
2645-3688-4657.description:
Activate five lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers five times, adding at least {5}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {5} and tapping it, untapping five lands.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping Staff of Domination.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may use it to activate Staff of Domination's other abilities.

654-2443-2660-5094.notablePrerequisites: Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
654-2443-2660-5094.description:
Activate Evolving Wilds by tapping and sacrificing it.
Evolving Wilds is put on the bottom of your library instead of in your graveyard due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Evolving Wilds ability, searching your library for Evolving Wilds and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
Evolving Wilds enters the battlefield, triggering Amulet of Vigor, untapping Evolving Wilds.
Repeat.

151-618-908-4925.description:
Pay {U} to Metathran Transport to make Kiki-Jiki blue.
Tap Kiki-Jiki to make a copy of Norritt.
Tap the copy to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
Cast To Arms! untapping all your creatures.
